title: Water & Ocean Wave 3 — source-page screening (NOT audition-ready)
screening_limitations: Freesound page metadata and license text checked; original audio, HQ preview duration/format and checksum NOT downloaded or independently probed.
Descriptions indicate claimed locations and acoustic identities, not independent acoustic verification.
An eligible declared duration DOES NOT mean listening approval, technical PASS or permission to release.

preproduction_conditions: verify actual media availability, duration and SHA256
audition to confirm claimed sound and no unwanted voices/noise
build 600s master without recycling a shorter recording
FFprobe, QA, loop-edge test, mobile/browser checks
publish noindex review-only page and obtain explicit owner listening approval

items.reason: Authentic bamboo strike not verified from a long, suitable CC0 recording; ordinary fountains must not be rebranded as bamboo.
